thread:
sarah: kicking off telemetry commissioning for ap-south2 GPU cluster (edge-gpu-3). goal is logs/metrics/traces + a minimal dashboard and alert set, then handoff to oncall-jordan. planning to do a low-retention logging tier to save $$$.

devon: noted. what's the target retention?

sarah: 7 days for raw logs, 30 days for indexed errors only. cheaper S3 tier for raw -> lifecycle to glacier in 14d.

ming: heads up: this region has MTU 8900 on the nodes but the default calico MTU was left at 1500 in the provisioning scripts. saw packet drops in the smoke tests.

sarah: oh — thanks. will update calico config in the bootstrap repo. can you paste the diff?

ming: sure, small yaml change: ```yaml
spec:
  config:
    veth_mtu: 8900
```

alex: also noticed RDMA not enabled in ap-south2 images; some of the model-serving pods expect ibverbs for NCCL in multi-gpu jobs. we should either disable RDMA-dependent configs or enable drivers on the node image.

devon: given timeline, i'd prefer disabling RDMA features in the runtime for now. track an action to enable on next image bake.

sarah: agreed. action items: 1) adjust calico MTU (ming) 2) toggle rdma flags in runtime helm values (devon) 3) push grafana/dashboard cfg + alert rules (alex) 4) cost retention lifecycle (sarah).

ops-bot: deployment pipeline started for telemetry-bootstrap-config (ci/telemetry-comm/ap-south2) — build 2026.3.14-77.

deploy-bot: canary apply success: namespace telemetry-ap-south2, configmaps updated (grafana-provisioning, loki-shipper).

alex: pushing a minimal grafana dashboard via provisioning configmap. panels: GPU utilization (per node), pod-level GPU memory, KV cache hit ratio (per model), request latencies p50/p95/p99.

sarah: can we have an alert for KV cache miss rate > 20% for 5m? that correlates with token cost and latency spikes.

alex: adding rule. quick snippet: ```yaml
alert: HighKVCacheMissRate
expr: sum(rate(kv_cache_miss_total[5m])) / sum(rate(kv_cache_requests_total[5m])) > 0.2
for: 5m
labels: {severity: warning, team: infra}
annotations: {summary: "KV cache miss rate >20%", runbook: "https://redwood.docs/runbooks/kv-cache"}
```

ming: also adding a network-level alert: pod_network_rx_errors_total > 100 for 10m — caught the earlier MTU fallout.

devon: about logs: please add a parsing rule to drop verbose debug lines from runtime libs (they're noisy). keep index on error.code and request_id only.

sarah: i'll add a short grok rule to the loki pipeline. devon, can you review the drop-list?

devon: yep. will review in the next 30m.

oncall-jordan: FYI, once alerts are live i'll want escalation: paging for severity=critical, slack only for warning. set pager duty to infra-oncall for critical.

sarah: good call. putting PD config in the alert labels + slack channel #eng-sre-observability.

alex: dashboard provisioning file applied. command used: `kubectl -n telemetry apply -f grafana/provisioning/dashboard-ap-south2.yaml`

ops-bot: smoke check: grafana reachable at https://grafana.ap-south2.redwood.internal, loki push success, traces sampled at 10%.

ming: tracer config: 10% global sampling, 50% for model-serving namespace. we can raise later.

devon: cost note: with 7d raw retention + 30d indexed errors, we estimate ~0.42 USD/hour for logs ingestion on this cluster assuming current load. if we increase traces to 20% sampling, add ~0.15 USD/hour.

sarah: thanks — i'll include that in the handoff note.

oncall-jordan: handoff checklist request: include runbook links, escalation policy, known caveats (MTU, RDMA), and the exact grafana panels to watch. send me the checklist in-channel when ready.

sarah: putting the checklist here: * runbooks: https://redwood.docs/runbooks/telemetry-commissioning * kv-cache runbook: https://redwood.docs/runbooks/kv-cache * PD escalation: https://redwood.docs/pagerduty/infra-oncall * caveats: MTU mismatch potential, RDMA disabled, reduced trace sampling * ops play: how to flip retention: `kubectl -n telemetry set configmap loki-retention --from-literal=raw_days=7` * rollback: revert grafana provisioning configmap to `grafana/provisioning/backups/2026-03-14.yaml`

devon: quick validation commands: `kubectl -n telemetry get pods` (expect all 3 loki pods Ready), `kubectl -n telemetry logs deploy/loki-shipper` (no parse errors), `curl -sS https://grafana.ap-south2.redwood.internal/api/health` -> should return 200 + ok.

alex: added a tiny runbook snippet to the dashboard annotations so oncall can jump to the query for each panel.

ops-bot: validation run result: loki pods [3/3], prom pushgateway healthy, traces exporter connected. one warning: `pod_network_rx_errors_total` spike observed on node gpu-node-12 — ming assigned.

ming: investigating gpu-node-12 now; looks like jumbo frames mismatch on a daemonset-configured interface. patching calico, draining and uncordoning node.

oncall-jordan: i'll stay on standby for 30m after the patch. please message here when done and include any follow-up actions.

sarah: patch applied, node drained, calico updated, node back in rotation. no more rx errors in the last 10m.

devon: final signoff: metrics, logs, traces are all ingesting, dashboard and alerts live, PD configured for critical. moving to handoff.

oncall-jordan: taking handoff. will monitor overnight. thanks team! :thumbsup:

sarah: leaving a short retrospective note in the runbook re: RDMA decision and cost tradeoffs. closing thread.
